title: Wire guided character creation into play flow
description:
Problem:
The b69j guided character creation flow is complete as `eshyra create-character`, but `eshyra play` still invokes the legacy `promptCharacterDraft` flow in `packages/cli/src/playCharacter.ts`. Playtest users therefore see the brittle manual-HP creator instead of the new rules-pack-backed wizard/finalized-character flow.

Required behavior:
- When no canonical PC exists, `play` must not use `promptCharacterDraft` for D&D 5e SRD.
- For D&D 5e SRD, `play` should either offer to run the new guided wizard inline and import the finalized character into the campaign DB, or offer to select/import an existing finalized character from `<dataRoot>/characters`.
- `/addpc` should use the same guided/import path.
- Retain the old `completeCharacterCreation` path only for Pathfinder or explicitly legacy/test paths until replaced.
- Preserve current `/defer` behavior if desired.

Implementation notes:
- Add a projection/import function from `FinalizedCharacter` into campaign character DB mutations.
- Reuse existing finalized record fields instead of asking for manual HP.
- Prefer sharing the import/projection path between session-zero startup and `/addpc`.
acceptance_criteria:
- D&D 5e SRD `eshyra play` session-zero flow no longer prompts with `Level-1 max HP:` when no canonical PC exists.
- `/addpc` uses the same finalized-character wizard/import path as initial play/session-zero.
- A finalized character can be imported into a campaign and becomes the active `pc-1`.
- Imported `pc-1` has name, class, ancestry, HP, and ability scores populated from the finalized character record.
- Legacy `completeCharacterCreation` remains available only for Pathfinder or explicit legacy/test paths.
- Tests cover the no-manual-HP D&D 5e SRD play/session-zero transcript and finalized-character import into campaign DB.
close_reason: Implemented guided/finalized character setup for D&D play and /addpc; added finalized-character campaign import and tests.
